I am an older woman in Kilimanjaro, and this small plot of mine is planted with bananas and intercropped with beans, as we often do here on the slopes. The soil is fertile from the mountain, but I will add some manure because bananas need plenty of food, and I also have a little urea from the voucher program to help the beans grow. At my age, I work slowly but steadily, so my children and I will tend this plot ourselves through the season without hiring help, as it is not very big. We depend on the rains—both the vuli and masika—and I do not have money for chemicals or irrigation.
